verdict.rationale: Penpot documents a community plugin marketplace of 113+ plugins covering accessibility, code, AI, and design-system tools. It also invites users to use community plugins or build their own on its plugin system. The 2022 community remark that a plugin system was not yet implemented predates these claims and does not concretely contradict the current marketplace. Missing for 10: specific evidence of icon and data-filler plugins, independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace's size and quality, and evidence that the ecosystem is 'large' relative to competitors.
